items.title: Stella says more McLaren parts are planned for Las Vegas, without naming components
items.summary: After Brazil, McLaren Team Principal Andrea Stella said additional parts would come at Las Vegas to complement the Interlagos package and form a foundation for the 2027 car. He named no components or measured gains; he also said cooler conditions helped McLaren in Brazil while hot-weather long-run consistency remains a work in progress.
items.why_it_matters: This is a team development plan, not an FIA submission. The latest FIA event-page check at 06:26 UTC returned HTTP 500 and the season index omitted Las Vegas, so the filing status remains unverified.
